$comment: The closed register of representability losses the spec-bundle extraction frontend declares (FR-093 "Declared losses"). Every DECLARED_LOSS diagnostic names exactly one `code` of this register; a loss with no row fails the crate's own test (FR-093-CON-3). IR v1.2 represents unconstrained values directly, so an unconstrained value is not a loss; a source that authors no presence beyond its multiplicity column is (FR-106-AC-5).

losses.construct: a `0..*` (or `*`) collection field: the multiplicity column is the only presence the source authors, and it cannot say whether the member must appear and may be empty
losses.lowering: `presence: optional`, the presence a lower bound of `0` authors; a required-but-possibly-empty collection is not expressible in the source

losses.construct: an extraction whose `availability.fields.lossy` is `true`: the engine did not interpret every entry it read (an unresolved placeholder, or a module declaring `compatibility_posture: declared-lossy`)
losses.lowering: the record is lowered from the declarations the engine returned; what the engine did not interpret reaches no IR node
